sanskrit_verse: यश् चैषां स्वामिनं कश्चिन् मोक्षयेत् प्राणसंशयात् । दासत्वात् स विमुच्येत पुत्रभागं लभेत च ॥
transliteration: yaś caiṣāṃ svāminaṃ kaścin mokṣayet prāṇasaṃśayāt | dāsatvāt sa vimucyeta putrabhāgaṃ labheta ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who liberates a master from mortal peril, by virtue of servitude, shall be released from all bondages and inherit the rights of a son.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through conscious act of liberation
Causation is established via life-preserving action
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with existential service
Restoration logic elevates servant to familial parity
Consciousness alignment transcends formal social rank
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A preserves the life of master B under threat THEN A's servitude status = nullified
IF servitude is dissolved THEN inheritance rights of sonhood SHALL be granted to former servant
IF act of preservation occurs THEN prior contractual obligations = void
IF consciousness of duty exceeds role definition THEN social identity upgrades automatically
supreme_court_application: In matters involving existential risk to a superior, any individual—regardless of caste, class, or contractual obligation—who acts to preserve that life shall be recognized as having fulfilled the highest Dharma. The court must declare such an individual free from prior bondages and entitled to full civil and familial rights equivalent to natural-born heirs. This principle supersedes all man-made statutes that contradict consciousness-driven justice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in the witnessed act of preservation, not in prior condition of subordination. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as: danger arises → servant acts → life preserved → bondage dissolves → sonship realized. Responsibility is proportional to the immediacy and purity of intent in preserving life. There is no punitive element; rather, reality itself reconfigures roles based on the supremacy of Dharma-conscious action.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Formal acknowledgment of life-saving act by community elders
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Former master publicly affirms release of bonds
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Legal documentation granting full familial rights
Integrity Reintegration Ceremony: Ritual inclusion into family lineage as per Vedic rites
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma prevails where consciousness overrides convention. Bondage ends where life is preserved. Sonship is realized when duty transcends form. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
